loading.note: Never on the priority image, which is eager by default.

style.when: the parent passes a fit or a position (a section background does)
style.note: Fit is cover or contain. Position is the keyword pair for the nine positions (top left, top, top right, left, center, right, bottom left, bottom, bottom right), or, for focal-point, the image's stored focal point as <x>% <y>%; with no stored focal point the declaration is left out and the stylesheet's centre applies. The frame fill itself comes from the shared stylesheets (SC-011), so no inline fill is required; one a platform writes is redundant and harmless. No custom property carries the focal point: the stylesheets give way to this inline style.

root.note: The image takes the class its parent gives it (salt-hero__image, salt-gallery__image and so on); media has no class of its own. sizes and srcset are the image slot's default from contract/image-sizes.json. Always one img, never inside picture and never beside source elements (SC-007).

zeroState: Not drawn when the image does not resolve.

notes.text: Alt precedence is the parent's: an explicit alt, else the stored alt, else empty (decorative).

An image is one img with srcset, sizes, width and height, never picture (SC-007). Formats (WebP, AVIF) are negotiated by each platform's image pipeline behind the srcset URLs, not chosen in the markup. The priority image carries fetchpriority="high" and is never loading="lazy" (section#priority-media).

Width and height are always drawn, the image's intrinsic size, also when the stylesheet makes it fill its frame (SC-007): they give the browser the aspect ratio before the image loads. The "when not fill" condition 0.1.0 drafted goes.

owes: Write the inline style object-fit and object-position the parent passes, with focal-point as the image's stored focal point (Payload's upload focalPoint, as <x>% <y>%), left out when none is stored; objectPosition() maps focal-point to nothing today (components/image-sizes.ts).
Drop x-image; take the parent's class; derive sizes from the same contexts.
Its picture_sources opt-in, which wraps the img in picture with source elements, is non-conforming (SC-007): drop it and negotiate formats in the image pipeline behind srcset.

Write the inline style object-fit and object-position when the parent passes a fit or a position: the nine positions as keyword pairs, and focal-point as the attachment's stored focal point as <x>% <y>%, left out when none is stored. It stores no focal point today, so focal-point draws the stylesheet's centre until it does.
